comment: The requests every generated server and SDK runs against union-lists-api's ShapeMutations (sdktest.LoadUnionRequests): drawShape takes Shape, a union its members' keys and required fields pick, as its whole body argument shape; pay takes Payment, a union its kind discriminates, as its body argument payment; checkout takes Checkout, an input whose payment holds a Payment and whose shapes hold Shapes. A server answers status. A 200's data is what the implementation answers: drawShape the shape it received, pay the payment's kind, and checkout the payment's kind, a colon and the number of shapes. A 400 is refused before the implementation runs. With input, it is the refusal of the input body every server answers: detail "Request body does not match the declared input", details.reason reason, and the field errors errors, each path to the rules it breaks, sorted, with a nested object's errors at the dotted path (payment.number); no errors means the problem has none. Without input, it is the refusal of the body argument parameter, as each server refuses an object argument: the Go route names the member's errors under the argument's path, and the TypeScript and Rust routers name the argument in details.parameter. sdk is what an SDK does with the body's arguments before it sends them: "sends" sends the body as it is, and an object refuses the call with the SDK's validation error, its field errors as errors are. A typed SDK (Go, Rust, Python) cannot hold a value no member reads, and skips the requests whose sdk is "sends" and whose status is 400.
